title: Missing Element in Sorted Array
summary: Provide the kth missing number in a sorted array of unique integers, starting from the first element.
statement: Provide the kth missing number in a sorted array of unique integers, starting from the first element.
constraints: nums is strictly increasing and k is positive.
Count missing integers starting after nums[0].
reference_solution:
def kth_missing_sorted(nums, k):
 missing=lambda i:nums[i]-nums[0]-i;low,high=0,len(nums)
 while low<high:
  middle=(low+high)//2
  if missing(middle)<k:low=middle+1
  else:high=middle
 return nums[0]+k+low-1
